title: Add predefined module-level `Env` instance
author: paduszyk
body_preview: Would you consider exposing a predefined `Env` instance, e.g. `environ.env`, in addition to the existing `Env` class? title: `Env.__contains__` ignores configured prefix
author: paduszyk
body_preview: When a prefix is set, Env.get_value uses the prefixed name, but `Env.__contains__` still checks only the raw key.  ### Current behavior  ```python def __contains__(self, var: _str):     return var in self.ENVIRON ```  ### Repro  ```python import environ  env = environ.Env() env.prefix = "DJANGO_" env.ENVIRON["DJANGO_DEBUG"] = "1"  env.get_value("DEBUG")  # returns "1" "DEBUG" in env          # ret...
